title: flow (either direction)
description: Backpressure. From a connector: slow down or stop sending actions (optionally only for one scope). From the runtime: stop sending low-priority events; the connector buffers or drops them per spec/PCP.md, Backpressure.

scope.description: Limit the signal to one room. Absent = whole connection.

action_types.description: Limit the signal to these action types (e.g. only send).

max_per_minute.description: With state=slow: the rate the sender can sustain.
